item.title: Three police staff leave jobs, 10 still under investigation amid audit of devices

item.title: Digital medication platform offline after records found to be ‘incorrectly modified’
item.description: Used by the aged care, disability, hospice, and community health sectors, MediMap is a real-time electronic charting system that allows staff to manage patient medication.

item.title: Dirt bike community in mourning after death of marshal over the weekend
item.description: Steve Dobbs died on Saturday while riding at the Thundercross Valley Dirt Bike Park.

item.title: Nurses tell court of air found in child’s feeding line

item.title: BBC apologises after racial slur shouted at actors during Baftas
